expected_behavior_change: V3 can identify its loaded client build and compare it with the currently served release manifest.
V3 uses memory-only Admin authentication and centralized Store/Scope context.
V3 reads Cloud canonical Admin config through TanStack Query and the shared canonical validator.
V3 does not read v2 localStorage or import v2 client-state modules.
A serving/client release mismatch blocks future formal write surfaces.
V3 exposes the locked two-step 12-menu and 53-destination route registry across desktop, tablet, and mobile shells.
V3 provides shared PageHeader, search/filter, table/card, status/state, draft, confirmation, readback, form, and timeline foundations without fabricated domain data.
Order monitoring remains read-only and exposes no refund, cancel-order, or payment-method-correction transaction mutation.
Shared Admin ACK contract receives a type-only literal preservation fix; runtime semantics are unchanged.
UI-01 Product Management defaults to a full-width Product List with search, category/status filters, sort, list/card view, responsive mobile cards and a temporary slide-over opening hook.
A query-gated isolated UI-01 public review mode renders clearly-labelled non-canonical fixture data and disables backend reads.
A branch-only Cloudflare Pages workflow publishes the isolated V3 UI preview without changing admin.morefunos.com routing.
non_goals: No production deploy or hostname routing.
No offline publish outbox in Gate 1.
No UI-02 editable Product Drawer fields in this slice.
No Product mutation or formal Draft mutation from the public preview.
No production Admin V3 hostname cutover; preview remains isolated from admin.morefunos.com.

notes: v3admin/** is the approved isolated ADMIN_V3 client scope.
.github/workflows/v3admin-ci.yml is reviewed as CI-only with zero deployment/routing behavior.
contracts/admin-config-sync-v1.ts change is type-only and runtime-semantic-neutral.
UI-01 public preview uses explicit non-canonical fixtures only for visual acceptance and performs no backend read/write in preview mode.
